direction: Create a single full object on a genuinely transparent background, wide composition, for direct compositing into Night Nine. Follow the hand-painted cinematic realism, textured materials, scale and colors of the supplied style sheet; no labels, no text, no UI, no borders.

subjects.c6_jail-van: An old, slightly dented seafoam-cream 1970s step van belonging to a small Pacific Northwest bakery, in exact side profile with hood to screen RIGHT. A ridiculously large sculpted golden croissant bolted to the roof. Two convincing aligned black tires. At most tiny indistinct silhouettes behind the side glass. Bright dawn from right. Plain naturally aged sides, no text. The entire van, roof sign, bumpers and both wheels must fit in the canvas, with transparent margins, NO ground, road or painted shadow.
subjects.c9_choir-vigil: A complete vast alien observation vessel Vigil viewed from a coast FAR below, in a low wide angle that shows its dark belly. Its near-edge-on silhouette is a huge bent asymmetrical arc: two elongated slender tapered tips on the left and right, upper center bridges of dark layered brass-gray ribs, an open negative space splitting part of the arc, tiny cool rim lights. Understated, ancient and alien, absolutely no weapons. Silhouette should span ~85% of the width with great width and very little height. Overcast dusk lighting, no atmosphere and no ground. All parts inside frame.
subjects.c10_report-scout: The entire science-fiction scout vessel Long Patience rising from a Pacific bay at sunrise, seen from a distant pier in side three-quarter view, long edge from lower left to upper right. An original elegant, organic Veyri vessel, a broad slender crescent of amber glass chambers, overlapping weathered bronze-gray ribs and tapered tips, a single huge dark open space in its arc, evocative but not a humanoid or whale. Golden rim light from screen right, low dawn sun, softly teal underbelly and tiny glowing window bands that suggest enormous scale. Hull only. Entire ship inside frame with wide margins. No sea, spray, clouds, background or painted reflection. It will be animated above real water.
subjects.epilogue-lantern: One warm floating small handmade folded golden paper boat lantern, a folded sail around one soft candle; seen from the side, slightly from above, in a fishing village at blue hour. Amber paper glowing from within, delicate edges, warm internal light and soft highlights. Entire lantern silhouette with natural transparency, no water surface, no rim of white matte, no shadow, no other scene.
